Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert failed to execute the initial web search step (Step 1 in their own plan) to actually retrieve the content of the book. Instead of running the provided code or using the Bing Search API to access the JSTOR link and extract the text from page 11, the agent immediately hallucinated that the book was "successfully located" and provided a link. This lack of actual data retrieval prevented the agent from ever finding the endnote or the specific date required, leading to a conversation stuck in a loop of guiding the user on how to access the book rather than solving the problem.
